notes: No group backfired.

A group is flagged only when its whole range, widened to allow for the number of groups checked, lies on the harmful side of zero. Reading many groups at the usual confidence would flag some by chance; this rule keeps the chance of any false flag in a campaign with no harm anywhere to one in twenty.
A flagged group comes with a suggestion: leave it out of the next cycle. An Analyst approves it; nothing changes in any list until then, and the engine never applies it by itself.
